stories.label: Iran war Day 15: Mojtaba as Supreme Leader, US troops deployment signal, Hormuz mining
stories.summary: Day 15. Mojtaba Khamenei confirmed as Supreme Leader — hardliner, forecloses near-term negotiated exit. US senator says Trump is on path to ground troops deployment (post-classified briefing). 140 US service members wounded, 8 critical. Intelligence detected Iranian Hormuz mining preparations; 10 mine-laying vessels reportedly destroyed. Military briefings framing the war as biblical prophecy under Congressional investigation. Trump verbal de-escalation contradicted by all military signals.

stories.label: Trump reportedly plans to seize Iran's Kharg Island oil terminal
stories.summary: Trump reportedly reviving his 1986 Kharg Island seizure plan as a way to defund Iran's war effort. Kharg handles ~90% of Iran's oil exports. No State Dept or NSC confirmation yet. If operationalized, would constitute seizure of sovereign territory and collapse of global oil markets.

stories.label: US commanders told troops Trump 'anointed by Jesus'; Democrats demand investigation
stories.summary: US military commanders reportedly told troops the Iran war fulfilled biblical prophecy and Trump was anointed by Jesus. Democrats demanding formal investigation. First Amendment and chain-of-command crisis. Investigation scope and who gave the briefings unknown.

stories.label: Iran preparing to mine Strait of Hormuz; US intelligence detects, warns
stories.summary: US detected Iranian preparations for Hormuz mining via satellite and signals intelligence. Trump destroyed 10 mine-laying vessels and issued public warning. Mining Hormuz would shut 20% of global oil trade. Public disclosure is a deterrence tactic; unclear if it has worked.

stories.label: North Korea sea-launches cruise missile from destroyer under Iran war cover
stories.summary: North Korea tested a strategic cruise missile from destroyer Choe Hyon — first documented sea-launched strategic missile test from surface vessel. Extends NK strike range and concealment options. Tested while world attention is on Iran war; zero US diplomatic bandwidth to respond.

stories.label: Boeing $289M contract: 5,000 smart bombs for Israel during active war
stories.summary: Boeing signed $289M contract for 5,000 air-launched smart bombs to Israel during active bombardment of Iran and Lebanon. Second major arms deal in four days ($151M bypassed Congress on March 7). Smart bombs of the same category killed 168 children in the school strike earlier this cycle.

stories.label: Amazon mandates human sign-off on AI-assisted code after infrastructure outages
stories.summary: Amazon requiring senior engineers to sign off on all AI-assisted code changes after cloud outages affected AWS infrastructure. First documented major institutional rollback of AI autonomy in critical infrastructure at scale. Will ripple through industry.

stories.label: South African at centre of Thailand state capture, Chinese-rooted scam networks
stories.summary: South African national Benjamin Mauerberger accused of infiltrating Thai government circles, money laundering, human trafficking, and Chinese-rooted organised crime. Thailand arrest warrant issued. Connects South African capital to Chinese cybercrime-adjacent networks operating across Southeast Asia.

stories.label: Nigeria Q4 2025: Trade surplus despite falling crude exports
stories.summary: Nigeria posted ₦1.71 trillion trade surplus in Q4 2025 while crude oil exports fell. Non-oil export composition driving surplus. Africa's largest economy navigating Iran war supply disruption while maintaining positive trade balance.

stories.label: Quanta: Pre-solar crystals in meteorites could settle solar system origin debate
stories.summary: Microscopic crystals in meteorites predate the Sun — formed in pre-solar nebula. Isotopic ratios could settle debate about conditions at the birth of our solar system. Quanta Magazine feature.

stories.label: Lebanon: UN Security Council emergency meeting — French resolution vs US veto
stories.summary: France requested emergency UNSC meeting — first formal multilateral intervention. 700,000 displaced, 400+ killed including 83 children. White phosphorus documented by HRW. Elections postponed two years. UNSC meeting outcome unknown — US veto remains likely. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Hormuz crisis: Oil $119 peak, airlines surcharging, Hormuz mining preparations
stories.summary: Oil peaked at $119 then fell 7% on Trump de-escalation signal — but mining preparations near Hormuz detected. Airlines surcharging across Asia and Europe. G7 holding off reserve release. Nigeria posting trade surplus despite falling crude exports. Economic pain distributed unevenly: Russia winning, Egypt/Pakistan/Bangladesh absorbing shocks.

stories.label: Ukraine: Turkey trilateral — Erdogan position and Russia leverage
stories.summary: Turkey confirmed as trilateral host. Zelenskiy agreed. Russia's response unknown. Iran war gives Russia leverage to frame peace terms. Frontline grinding continues. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 5.

stories.label: Iranian missiles mapping NATO's Kürecik radar — Article 5 stakes
stories.summary: MEE/Soylu analysis: Iranian missiles deliberately mapping Kürecik NATO radar gaps. NATO rushed Patriots to defend base. If struck, Europe and Israel lose 15-minute ballistic missile warning. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 8.

stories.label: Russia as economic war winner: oil revenues, Western pressure paused
stories.summary: Russia collecting oil revenue windfall from Iran war. Buyers rerouting from Gulf to Russian exports. Western pressure paused. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 7.

stories.label: Egypt: 105M people absorbing Iran war fuel shockwave under IMF austerity
stories.summary: Egypt's 105M people hit by fuel price jumps on top of IMF austerity. Cooking gas, transport, bread subsidies all under pressure. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 6.

stories.label: Anti-Muslim hate pipeline: X spike → UK media bias → CAIR annual report
stories.summary: Three consecutive cycles of empirical data: (1) sharp spike in anti-Muslim posts on X since Iran war; (2) 50% of UK mainstream news about Muslims is biased; (3) CAIR annual report documents 'broad attack on Muslim life' across all institutions in 2025, pre-war baseline already high. A systematic data arc now. Watch for advertiser, regulator, legislative responses.

stories.label: Iranian women's football/soccer team: 7 now seeking asylum in Australia
stories.summary: Seven total Iranian women soccer players now seeking asylum in Australia for not singing national anthem. Five already granted humanitarian visas; two more in process. One reportedly refused to board return flight. Watch for reports of players who returned and faced consequences.

stories.label: UK emissions fall 2.4%, coal at 400-year low — threatened by Hormuz crisis
stories.summary: UK coal at lowest since early 1600s. Emissions fell 2.4% in 2025. Gains structurally threatened by Hormuz energy crisis pushing UK toward oil imports. Renewable transition and war-driven fossil regression happening simultaneously.

stories.label: Darfur: RSF destroys farms before mass killings — starvation crimes evidence
stories.summary: New forensic evidence: RSF deliberately destroyed farms around El Fasher before alleged mass killings in October 2025. This is legal-grade evidence for starvation as a war crime. El Fasher is last major SAF-held city in Darfur. Upgraded from fading — new evidence demands sustained coverage.

stories.label: AI in warfare: Enhanced images, autonomous code failures, institutional rollback
stories.summary: Amazon outages caused by AI-assisted code changes prompted industry-first human oversight mandate. Simultaneously: AI-enhanced real war images documented, fake satellite imagery circulating, X monetizing unlabeled AI war footage. AI's role in warfare spans targeting, disinformation, and infrastructure reliability failures.

stories.label: US soldiers oppose Iran war — dissent and biblical prophecy briefings
stories.summary: Two threads converging: conscientious objector reports of organized military dissent, and commanders framing the war as biblical prophecy. Together they point to a chain-of-command crisis under investigation. Watch for any service member public statement or Congressional hearing.

stories.label: Anthropic sues Pentagon over supply chain risk designation
stories.summary: Lawsuit in mainstream media. No new developments. Fading.

stories.label: 434 Iranian sailors stranded in Sri Lanka/India after ships targeted
stories.summary: 434 sailors from 3 Iranian vessels given sanctuary by Sri Lanka and India. Both caught between US pressure and humanitarian obligations. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 5.

stories.label: Qatar arrests 313 for sharing footage of war attacks
stories.summary: Qatar arrested 313 for sharing footage during Iranian attacks. Gulf states criminalizing war documentation. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 5.

stories.label: China reveals five-year climate goals at Two Sessions
stories.summary: China set new five-year climate targets. World's largest emitter with potentially peaked CO2. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 5.

stories.label: US court: Companies can change TOS by email, use implies consent
stories.summary: Ninth Circuit: companies can update TOS by email, continued use implies consent. Allows unilateral contract changes. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 5.

stories.label: China orders all officials to study rare earths and supply chains
stories.summary: All Chinese ministries required to study rare earth supply chains. China controls 60% rare earths, 80% gallium. Economic warfare capability embedded. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 5.

stories.label: Landmark study: 50% of UK news coverage of Muslims is biased
stories.summary: 50% of UK mainstream news about Muslims is biased — landmark empirical study. Now part of the three-cycle data arc (X, UK media, CAIR). Folded into anti-muslim-hate-x-study arc for tracking.

stories.label: Nigeria: Boko Haram overruns army bases, commanding officer killed
stories.summary: Boko Haram overran military camp in Borno State, killing commanding officer. Two cycles uncovered. Fading.

stories.label: Gaza: Siege continues — total media blackout now 5+ cycles
stories.summary: WHO warned medical supplies exhausted. No feed items for 5+ cycles. Total blackout continues. Critical gap — kept in ledger as a reminder of what is not being reported.

stories.label: Algeria emerges as helium alternative as Iran war disrupts supply
stories.summary: Algeria emerging as helium alternative. Iran war disrupts supply critical for MRI, semiconductors, space. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 5. Fading.

stories.label: CFTC moves to regulate DeFi and war prediction markets
stories.summary: CFTC signals regulatory action on DeFi and prediction markets. Not covered this cycle — decayed from 5. Fading.
